citation: NASA LRO LOLA polar GDR, south of 85 S, 10 m/px
grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 31 deg
resolution_note: source product is 10 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 2.5 m/px spans 256 x 128 source posts and is a 4x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
note: A south-polar massif with near-permanent Earth line of sight, which is what makes it a landing candidate. Steep and lit at a grazing angle.
